class Employee:
    def __init__(self, id):
        self.id = id
        self.boss = None
        self.signed_documents = set()

    def set_boss(self, boss):
        self.boss = boss

    def sign_document(self, document_id):
        self.signed_documents.add(document_id)

    def has_signed_document(self, document_id):
        return document_id in self.signed_documents

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    index = 0
    n = int(data[index])
    m = int(data[index + 1])
    index += 2
    
    employees = [Employee(i) for i in range(1, n + 1)]
    
    for _ in range(m):
        event_type = int(data[index])
        index += 1
        
        if event_type == 1:
            x = int(data[index])
            y = int(data[index + 1])
            index += 2
            employees[x - 1].set_boss(employees[y - 1])
        elif event_type == 2:
            x = int(data[index])
            index += 1
            current = employees[x - 1]
            while current.boss is not None:
                current.boss.sign_document(current.id)
                current = current.boss
            current.sign_document(current.id)
        elif event_type == 3:
            x = int(data[index])
            document_id = int(data[index + 1])
            index += 2
            current = employees[x - 1]
            while current.boss is not None:
                current = current.boss
            if current.has_signed_document(document_id):
                print("YES")
            else:
                print("NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
